paragraphs.text: I am convinced five is my best blocking number, though six also looks pretty decent.
A four feels inconsequential. I do not think I should be targeted, but of course I am.
I have a double payout on an eight, which is phenomenal.
I am not on many good numbers: only three distinct numbers across five accesses, so it is tough.
My plan had been to roll an eight, do my shenanigans, and then roll a seven next turn so Orange would get smushed.
Red seemed to be taking his sweet time.
This is a weird game; the whole vibe feels strange.
